title: DOW-UAP-D61, Mission Report, Persian Gulf, August 2020
doc_notes: This is a declassified mission report (MISREP) from the Department of War regarding an ISR flight in the Persian Gulf, which includes a brief mention of an unidentified aerial formation observation.

encounters.summary: A formation of unknown flying objects was observed by an ISR aircraft sensor traveling NE-NW along the coast for approximately two minutes before being lost in cloud cover.
encounters.quote: observed a formation of flying objects traveling NE-NW along the coast
